time_range.end: after Lisha wedding and bandit suppression

periods.label: Provisional king and husband of five queens

name.jp: ルクス・アーカディア

periods.nationality: New Kingdom Rodgalia / former Arcadia Empire

status.public_role: becomes king and marries Lisha, Celistia, Kururushifa, Philphy and Yatoro
status.condition: busy but physically enhanced by Baptism

appearance.overview: Silver-haired young man seen in formal wear, academy clothing, and Drag-Ride gear during public duties and travel.

personality.summary: Gentle, dutiful and stubbornly self-sacrificing; tries to answer every bond sincerely rather than choosing convenience.
desires: stand beside all five brides fairly
personality.inner_conflict: Must accept kingship and five marriages while retaining his ordinary bonds and moral restraint.

decision_pattern.style: chooses the hardest honest path if it protects another person's dignity

address_pattern.celistia-langris: 赛莉丝学姐 / 赛莉丝

quote_samples: 我想让夜架像人类一样活着。

habits.daily_routine: travels between academy, capital, allied states and noble territories while handling royal duties
quirks: tries to do chores or caregiving himself

preferences.peace: prefers earned trust over coercive power

background.upbringing: Former imperial prince who became a criminal-symbol handyman after the revolution.
background.pre_story: Saved the world and accepted one-year provisional kingship.

lisharhti-atismata.summary: Final wedding partner; they pledge to support the New Kingdom together.

celistia-langris.summary: Visits her western home and accepts her wish to be spoiled.

kururushifa-enfolderk.summary: She proposes the five-marriage solution and shares a night at the Tunnel ruins.

philphy-aignram.summary: Their bond is reaffirmed as mutual desire to stay together without needing excuses.

yatoro-kirihime.summary: Duel pact convinces her eventually to accept becoming queen while still testing his vigilance.

airi-arcadia.summary: He cares for her during recovery; they reaffirm mutual dependence.

seren-triaden.summary: One of the Three Harmonies who becomes his official guard.

teifa-triaden.summary: Warm guard who wishes to stay near him even beyond friendship.

nokotte-triaden.summary: Schedules and cares for him with precise loyalty.

ariel-vi-arcadia.summary: Ruins manager who loves him but chooses not to burden him yet.

secrets: Romantic memories from the Ouroboros loop influence the five-marriage decision.
periods.summary: Central figure of the final volume: Lux becomes provisional king, makes diplomatic and family visits with each bride, reconciles with Airi, formalizes the Three Harmonies as guards, marries Lisha, and later defeats the Hounds' leader without killing him.

key_events.summary: Accepts Kururushifa's proposal to marry all five heroines while becoming king.
Challenges Yatoro's wish to remain only a shadow protector and wins a later two-duel pact.
Marries Lisha in Rodgalia and begins the New Kingdom's dawn.
Defeats the Hounds leader using Bahamut and refined anticipation tactics.
